summary: 新西兰企业 Izon 将测量微小颗粒的 qNano 仪器推向美国研究市场。由于用途取决于客户的课题，逐次演示、培训和持续跟进既帮助销售，也为后续开发提供问题线索。
logic: 从新西兰进入美国市场
以演示和跟进了解客户
用研究反馈改进产品与培训

paragraphs.brief: 伊松新的美国总部位于马萨诸塞州剑桥，这是最重要的全球科学研究和技术中心之一。
sentences: The new US headquarters of Izon are situated in Cambridge, Massachusetts, one of the most important global centres of scientific research and technology.
伊松新的美国总部位于马萨诸塞州剑桥，这是最重要的全球科学研究和技术中心之一。
Half the other offices in the building Izon shares have scientific names like Stemgent, or the word ‘pharmaceutical’ in the name.
伊桑大楼的其他办公室有一半拥有像斯坦根这样的科学名称，或名字中的“制药”一词。
In the past three years, Izon has expanded to 17 times its previous size.
过去三年来，伊桑的面积已扩大至以前17倍。
It’s done so selling only one product that it’s been developing since 2004, the qNano.
该公司只出售了2004年以来开发的一件产品，即QNano。
This is an adjustable tool for the measurement and analysis of tiny particles in scientific research, which comes with a $27,000 price tag.
这是一个可调整的工具，用于测量和分析科学研究中的微粒，其价格为27 000美元。
Izon’s success results from the fact that the qNano machine provides precise measurements, while similar machines of the same price only offer averaging techniques.
伊桑的成功是因为QNano机器提供了精确的测量数据，而价格相同的类似机器只能提供平均技术。
In effect, researchers using the qNano are able to gather information about very small things, and it has many possible applications from drug delivery analysis through to environmental research.
实际上，使用qNano的研究人员能够收集非常小的东西的信息，从药物交付分析到环境研究，它有许多可能的应用。

paragraphs.brief: 克莉丝多佛·博伦是伊桑的美国销售负责人。
sentences: Kristoffer Bolen is Izon’s US head of sales.
克莉丝多佛·博伦是伊桑的美国销售负责人。

Alongside his full-time role with the company, he’s just finished the fifth semester of six for his High-Tech Master of Business Administration at Northeastern University, which will be his second master’s degree, alongside a Master of Science.
他除了在公司担任全职职务外还在东北大学的高级理商管理硕士上完成了六年级的第五学期这将是他的第二硕士学位还有一个理科硕士学位

These soon-to-be twin master’s degrees provide Bolen with the perfect combination of skills for his job, which depends on him being able to manage the sales process and also comprehend in depth a very complicated piece of technology.
这些即将成为双胞胎的硕士学位为Bolen的工作提供了完美的技能组合，这取决于他能否管理销售过程，并深入理解非常复杂的技术。
When a customer buys a qNano device, an Izon representative will fly anywhere in America to train them how to use the instrument.
当顾客购买QNano设备时，一个Izon代表将飞到美国任何地方训练他们如何使用该仪器。
The representative then checks in with the client on an ongoing basis to be completely informed about how each qNano is being used, and then liaises with technicians back in New Zealand.
该代表接着不断与客户联系，以便完全了解如何使用每克纳诺，然后与新西兰境内的技术人员联络。

paragraphs.brief: 汉斯・范德・沃恩是无目的的，卖掉了自己的公司，并正在寻找一些更累人的东西使他的头脑。
sentences: The Izon story started 8 years ago in New Zealand.
伊桑的故事始于八年前的新西兰。
Hans van der Voorn was aimless, having sold his own company, and was looking for something more taxing to set his mind to.
汉斯・范德・沃恩是无目的的，卖掉了自己的公司，并正在寻找一些更累人的东西使他的头脑。
Van der Voorn was introduced to three scientists with an idea that involved simply a small plastic membrane with a tiny adjustable hole to measure a range of very small particles.
Van der Voorn 被介绍给三位科学家其想法只是涉及一个小塑料膜和一个小的可调整洞用来测量一系列非常小的粒子
Initially he put up an investment of $1.5 million to move the process forward to the development of a prototype, and this led to the founding of Izon and the production of the qNano.
他最初投入了150万美元，将这一进程推向开发一个原型，这导致了伊桑的创建和克纳诺的制作。
Van der Voorn believes that the worlds of science and business sometimes don’t understand each other very well.
Van der Voorn认为，科学与商业界有时不太了解对方。
However, he thinks that engineering can be a bridge between the two, and his long experience in that field has been crucial to the company’s success.
然而，他认为工程可以成为两者之间的桥梁，他在这一领域的长期经验对于公司的成功至关重要。
He soon realised that Izon was going to need people on the ground overseas if it was going to grow, so the US office was opened.
他很快意识到伊桑需要海外的人才能成长所以美国办事处已经开张了
For now Izon trades in the US as a foreign company, so avoids the high level of compliance that comes with being an American-registered company.
现在伊桑作为一家外国公司在美国进行交易，因此避免了高度遵守规定，而这是一家在美国注册的公司。
But he sees that one day soon this will change, as Izon’s current position disallows it from entering into partnerships locally.
也因为伊桑目前的立场不允许他在当地建立合伙关系。

paragraphs.brief: 所以对伊桑来说，销售本身还不够；客户如何使用QNano也与销售有关。
sentences: Marketing the qNano is complicated.
QNano的营销很复杂
Izon needs scientists both to buy and advertise the product.
伊桑需要科学家来购买和广告产品。
The science world may seem like a big playing field, but it’s actually a small group.
科学界似乎是一个大游戏场但它其实是个小团体
As a result, the critical part of the company’s marketing is articles that clients publish describing work they have performed with the qNano.
因此，公司营销的关键部分是客户发表文章，描述他们与QNano公司一起开展的工作。
So for Izon the sale isn’t enough in itself; it also has a stake in how customers are using the qNano.
所以对伊桑来说，销售本身还不够；客户如何使用QNano也与销售有关。
That’s where Yaniv Gaynor comes in.
亚尼夫·盖诺尔就是从那里进来的。
As development and training manager, he’s involved throughout the sales process and manages most of the customer’s post-sale experience.
身为发展和训练经理，他参与整个销售过程，并管理客户在销售后的大部分经验。
The sales process is new for Gaynor, who shifted cities and switched from a role as teacher at the University of Minnesota to his first private sector role with Izon.
Gaynor的销售过程很新，他改变了城市，从明尼苏达大学的教师角色转变为他在伊桑的第一个私营部门角色。
‘It’s tricky, it’s challenging, and it’s not in my comfort zone,’ he concedes.
"这很棘手，很有挑战性，而且它不在我的舒适区，"他承认了。
But nine out of ten times, if there’s an unhappy customer, he’s able to turn their experience around.
但是十次中九次如果有一个不开心的顾客他就能改变他们的经历
And there’s another part to this, because sitting with customers as they learn about the qNano, Gaynor gets to see how they are using the product.
并且还有另外一个部分，因为当顾客了解QNano时，他们坐在他们身边，Gaynor 就能知道他们是如何使用这个产品的。
‘People ask very good questions, and these are great triggers for future development,’ he says.
他说，这些是未来发展的极好触发因素：“人们问的很好。”

paragraphs.brief: 范德沃恩说：「我们的企业在出售研究工具。
sentences: ‘Our business is selling research tools,’ van der Voorn says.
范德沃恩说：「我们的企业在出售研究工具。
But he knows that the application range of this tool is wide.
但他知道这个工具的应用范围很广。
For instance, Izon is engaged in a project with Harvard University, looking for a particular type of particle of blood that is a symptom of the medical condition of thrombosis.
例如，Izon与哈佛大学合作开展一个项目，寻找一种特殊的血栓病症状血粒子。
If in the future they can identify this particle, they can design a simple test for it.
如果将来他们能识别出这个粒子，他们就可以设计一个简单的测试。
This would make it easier for doctors to diagnose thrombosis.
这将使医生更容易诊断血栓症。
Another planned development is eventually to shift the US base to more spacious offices on the other side of town.
另一项计划发展是最终将美国基地转移到城的另一边更宽敞的办公室。

With larger headquarters, the company will be able to bring clients into the Izon building for training with its product, rather than travelling to them, which will hopefully result in an even closer relationship between the company and its customers.
随着总部的扩大，公司将能够将客户带入伊松大楼，用其产品进行培训，而不是前往他们那里，这有望使公司与客户之间的关系更加密切。

items.en: Izon’s new US headquarters are located in an area popular with other science businesses.
items.zh: 伊桑的新美国总部位于一个与其他科学企业十分受欢迎的地区。
items.why: “global centres of scientific research and technology + 同楼多家科企” 共同证明该地聚集科研企业，等价于题干的“popular with other science businesses”。故为 TRUE.

items.en: Izon’s growth in the last three years has been faster than the company predicted.
items.zh: 伊桑在过去三年中的增长速度比该公司预计的要快。
items.why: 文中仅给出实际增幅，未出现任何关于公司预期/预测的比较信息。不能推断“快于预期”。故为 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: Since 2004, Izon has developed a range of equipment for use in scientific research.
items.zh: 自2004年以来，伊桑开发了用于科学研究的一系列设备。
items.why: 题干说“一系列设备 (a range of equipment)”, 原文明确“only one product”。与事实相反，故 FALSE。

items.en: One advantage of the qNano is that it is cheaper than its competitors.
items.zh: QNano的好处之一是它比竞争对手便宜。
items.why: 原文强调“同价位”,优势在精度而非价格更低。题干“更便宜”与原文矛盾，故 FALSE.

items.en: Drug delivery analysis will be the most profitable application of the qNano.
items.zh: 药物供应分析将是QNano最有利可图的应用。
items.why: 只列举应用范围，未提及“最盈利/最赚钱"。信息缺失，故 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: Kristoffer Bolen is still completing his studies.
items.zh: 克里斯多佛·博伦还在完成学业
items.why: 博伦的课程一共六个学期，当时刚完成第五学期，说明学业仍未结束。

items.en: Bolen’s job requires him to fully understand how the qNano works.
items.zh: 博伦的工作要求他充分理解克纳诺是如何运作的。
items.why: “comprehend in depth (深入理解) ”与题干“fully understand (充分/完全理解) ”语义等值于考试语境。故 TRUE.

items.en: He made the ________ which enabled the prototype to be created.
items.why: 回到对应内容“他最初投入了150万美元，将这一进程推向开发一个原型，这导致了伊桑的创建和克纳诺的制作”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: His background in ________ as well as business gave him the skills to run Izon.
items.zh: 除了商业经验，他在________方面的背景也使他具备了经营 Izon 的能力。
items.why: 题干与原文“工程 + 商业” 呼应。能与 business 并列作为背景的只有 engineering。

items.en: The company’s marketing relies on ________ about its customers’ research.
items.zh: Izon 的市场推广依靠介绍客户研究成果的________。
items.why: 直接同词复现，且与“about its customers’ research”语义一致。

items.en: Yaniv Gaynor was formerly a ________, with no experience in sales.
items.zh: 亚尼夫·盖诺以前是一名________，没有销售经验。
items.why: 原文直给职业身份 teacher。

items.en: To diagnose thrombosis, a ________ may be developed.
items.zh: 为了诊断血栓，未来可能会开发一种________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“如果将来他们能识别出这个粒子，他们就可以设计一个简单的测试”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: ________ will be done at Izon’s US headquarters.
items.zh: ________将在 Izon 的美国总部进行。
items.why: 空格对应将来在总部进行的活动即 training。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 第 1 段 · 第 3 句
第 4 段 · 第 4 句
points: 原文强调“同价位”,优势在精度而非价格更低。题干“更便宜”与原文矛盾，故 FALSE.
回到对应内容“如果将来他们能识别出这个粒子，他们就可以设计一个简单的测试”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: “that the worlds of science and business sometimes don’t understand each other very well”补足 believes 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 believes 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
For now Izon trades in the US as a foreign company, so avoids the high level of compliance ….
“that comes with being an American-registered company”修饰前面的 level。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 level，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: Izon is a New Zealand company specialising in nanoscience – the study of atoms, molecules and other very small pieces of matter.
伊桑是一家新西兰公司，专门研究纳米科学，研究原子、分子和其他非常小的物质。
